onAirCsv.title: OnAir CSV source
onAirCsv.help: Choose the OnAir CSV folder and filename prefix for this project. For example, ES_ uses ES_titles.csv. Saving does not read the files.
onAirCsv.invalidPrefix: Use only letters, numbers, _ or -, and end the prefix with _.
onAirCsv.defaultTemplatesHelp: Use these project templates only when a location or phone row has no Template value. A Template exported in the CSV always takes priority.
onAirCsv.invalidDefaultTemplates: Fallback templates must be text values.
onAirCsv.invalidPath: Enter an absolute folder path (Windows drive, UNC, or POSIX path).
onAirCsv.chooseError: Could not open the folder picker.

onAirMappings.title: OnAir CSV mappings
onAirMappings.help: Map a detected CSV graphic template to one of this project's sections. This only prepares a local mapping; it does not send PLAY.
onAirMappings.loadError: Could not read the loaded OnAir catalog.
onAirMappings.noSnapshot: No CSV is loaded for this project. Open OnAir and load the configured CSV folder first.
onAirMappings.noTemplates: The loaded CSV has no graphic templates to map.
onAirMappings.sourceReadOnly: Name comes from the loaded CSV or this project's fallback template.
onAirMappings.empty: No OnAir graphic mappings for this project.
onAirMappings.noSection: Choose a section before mapping fields.
onAirMappings.playbackHelp: These settings apply to PLAY requests for this CSV template. Automatic duration resumes the section after the selected number of seconds.
onAirMappings.destinationHelp: Each line receives the selected CSV value, or both values joined by the separator when a second field is selected.
onAirMappings.sectionInUse: This section is used by an OnAir CSV mapping. Remove or move that mapping first.
onAirMappings.targetInUse: This template is used by an OnAir CSV field mapping. Remove or update that mapping first.

validation.required: Choose a value for this mapping.
validation.duplicateSource: This CSV graphic already has a mapping.
validation.invalidSourceField: Choose a field from this CSV graphic type.
validation.invalidTarget: A mapped LiveBoard template no longer exists.
validation.invalidTargetFields: Enter at least one destination field name.

staticGraphics.title: Project static graphics
staticGraphics.help: Add graphics with fixed values that do not come from Plasma or CSV. Choose a LiveBoard section and its destination fields.
staticGraphics.empty: This project has no static graphics.
staticGraphics.name: Graphic name
staticGraphics.templateOnly: The graphic can play its template without extra fields.
staticGraphics.sectionInUse: This section is used by a project static graphic.
staticGraphics.targetInUse: A destination field is used by a project static graphic.

projects.activeProject: Active project for incoming Plasma requests
projects.emptyHelp: Create a project to define its sections, field mappings, interactions, and working mode.
projects.imported: Project imported as a new draft. Save settings to keep it.
projects.importError: The project file is invalid or unsupported.
projects.plasmaEnabled: This project receives plasma.test requests when active.
projects.csvHelp: This project uses CSV exports in the OnAir workspace and does not receive Plasma requests.
projects.csvSourcesHelp: This project uses CSV files; Plasma source mappings do not apply.
projects.standalonePlasmaBlocked: The active project uses CSV. Incoming Plasma PLAY requests are blocked.
projects.invalidConfig: Check project names and settings before saving.

mos.title: MOS mappings
mos.description: Map each Plasma source template to one or two target templates, then save the configuration locally.
mos.emptySections: No sections yet. Add a section to start mapping.
mos.targetsHelp: Choose one template, or two templates that alternate buffers.
mos.resumeDelayHelp: Applied only when two targets alternate buffers.
mos.sourcesHelp: One section can accept multiple source templates.
mos.emptyMappings: No field mappings. This is valid for graphic-only templates.
mos.resumeMappingHelp: Enter one destination field per row. Repeat a Plasma parameter on another row to map it to another LiveBoard field. Leave a cell empty to ignore that parameter for this destination. RESUME uses only the template name.
mos.fixValidation: Fix the validation issues before saving.
mos.leaveBody: Your edits have not been saved.

validation.incompleteMapping: Complete the mapping for every target

consoleMapping.title: MOS mapping resolution
consoleMapping.graphicOnly: {{template}} has no configured text fields (graphic-only template).
consoleMapping.resumeNoParams: RESUME command: only the template name is used; no parameter mappings are required.
consoleMapping.pairDelay: Configured buffer pause: RESUME → PLAY, {{ms}} ms
consoleMapping.notExecuted: Configuration report only. This request has been received; no LiveBoard action was executed.
consoleMapping.unmapped: No saved mapping matches this template.
consoleMapping.invalid-request: Request template or parameters are invalid. No mapping was resolved.
consoleMapping.settings-error: Mapping settings could not be read. No mapping was resolved.
consoleMapping.project-disabled: Plasma execution is disabled for this project.
consoleMapping.projectDisabledHelp: The active project uses CSV. No Plasma mapping or LiveBoard action was run.

mos.stepIdentityHelp: Name the section and enter the LiveBoard destination template names.
mos.stepTimingHelp: Set the propagation pause and the RESUME to PLAY transition delay for paired buffers.
mos.stepSourcesHelp: Map Plasma parameters to LiveBoard fields and choose how each source exits.

interactions.title: Interactions
interactions.help: Choose the triggering section and order the actions. Automatic-exit restoration uses the duration already configured for the triggering graphic.
interactions.name: Rule name
interactions.sectionInUse: This section is used by an interaction rule. Remove or update those rules before deleting it.

validation.invalidDelay: Delay must be an integer from 0 to 60000 ms
validation.invalidReference: Section or destination no longer exists
validation.unexpectedField: This action has an incompatible option
validation.invalidEvent: Suspend is only available before PLAY
validation.conflictingActions: Suspend cannot be combined with STOP or PLAY for the same section
validation.duplicateEventTarget: Another enabled rule already targets this section for the same event
validation.interactionCycle: A rule cannot target its own trigger section

liveBoard.title: LiveBoard execution
liveBoard.runtimeHelp: Review simulated actions or control the configured TCP connection. TCP acceptance does not confirm on-air output.
liveBoard.connectionHelp: Simulation is the default. TCP connects only when you press Connect.
liveBoard.dataDelayHelp: Wait after setting fields before RESUME or PLAY.
liveBoard.protocolAccepted: TCP connection established. Command acknowledgements are shown in each execution report; this status does not confirm on-air output.

saveDenied.LIVEBOARD_BUSY: A LiveBoard operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then save again.
saveDenied.MOS_MAPPINGS_ACTIVE: Stop the indicated sections ({{sections}}) before changing MOS mappings.
saveDenied.LIVEBOARD_CONNECTION_ACTIVE: Stop the indicated sections ({{sections}}) before changing LiveBoard connection settings.
saveDenied.LIVEBOARD_PROJECT_SWITCH_ACTIVE: Stop the indicated sections ({{sections}}) before switching the active project.
saveDenied.LIVEBOARD_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: The selected project no longer exists. Refresh the project list and try again.

projectSwitchDenied.LIVEBOARD_BUSY: A LiveBoard operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then switch projects.
projectSwitchDenied.LIVEBOARD_PROJECT_SWITCH_ACTIVE: Stop the indicated sections ({{sections}}) before switching the active project.
projectSwitchDenied.LIVEBOARD_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: The selected project no longer exists. Refresh the project list and try again.

liveBoard.helpBody: For a local TCP test, run npm run mock:liveboard in the LB-Portal project directory, then set host 127.0.0.1 and port 9010.
liveBoard.noSections: No LiveBoard sections are configured yet. Add mappings first.
liveBoard.resyncNote: This changes LB-Portal's local assumption only; it does not verify LiveBoard output.

confirmation.simulated: Simulated only. No LiveBoard command was sent.
confirmation.protocol-acknowledged: The protocol accepted the command; on-air output is not confirmed.
